2123110759286931695.en_summary: $NVDA interim CEO Colette Kress is moving up company-wide pay raises and additional equity grants by several months, a clear sign that retaining talent has become a major priority following Jensen Huang’s departure.
2123110759286931695.zh_summary: $NVDA 臨時執行長 Colette Kress 將公司全體加薪和額外股票授予提前數個月實施，顯示在 Jensen Huang 離任後，留住人才已成為主要優先事項。

ticker_notes.NVDA: 臨時執行長提前實施加薪和股票授予，以留住人才，回應 Jensen Huang 離任

2123110072792625299.en_summary: OpenAI reports up to 14% PPA improvement on $AMD flagship GPU IP designs. Its AI models rewrote SystemVerilog RTL, delivering roughly a year's worth of chip-design progress in less than 5 months, with some changes moving into production. AMD verified single-digit PPA improvements on upcoming CPU blocks, and OpenAI's Jalapeño chip saw 13% and 10% area reductions verified on silicon. OpenAI is also developing GPT-Synopsys with Synopsys.
2123110072792625299.zh_summary: OpenAI 報告稱其 AI 模型在 $AMD 旗艦 GPU IP 設計上實現高達 14% 的 PPA 改進。模型重寫 SystemVerilog RTL，在不到 5 個月內達成約一年的晶片設計進度，部分改動已進入生產。AMD 驗證了即將推出的 CPU 區塊有個位數 PPA 改進，OpenAI 的 Jalapeño 晶片在矽片上驗證了向量單元約 13% 和矩陣單元 10% 的面積減少。OpenAI 也正與 Synopsys 合作開發 GPT-Synopsys。

ticker_notes.AMD: OpenAI AI 模型為旗艦 GPU IP 帶來高達 14% PPA 改進，部分已進入生產，並驗證於 CPU 和自有晶片
